S037-01.notes: Reading 'far outside' the predicted range = anomalous. Routine contradicts; conclusive contradicts the recheck; redundant is illogical.

S037-02.notes: Dish rack, parking meter, puddle are everyday subjects = mundane. Exotic/controversial/ancient unsupported by examples.

flags: minor: Andes finding (torpor more often/deeper with low fat) is a reasonable simplification of Wolf et al. 2020, which linked torpor use to body mass/energy stores; acceptable
S037-03.notes: Text sets up high energy need, then explains torpor as the survival mechanism. A, C, D unsupported/too narrow.

flags: minor: key is the longest choice and the only one that synthesizes both findings; distractors are clearly wrong so cue is mild
S037-04.notes: Cross-fostered pups adopt the rearing colony's dialect (learned, not inherited) and queen removal increases variability until a new queen (queen helps maintain). A contradicts fostering; B contradicts stronger response to own dialect; C contradicts 'more varied' chirps. Consistent with Barker et al. 2021 Science.

S037-05.notes: Conclusion requires a comparison of observed vs unobserved rates; only A gives both. B and C give one figure each; D obscures the gap. No distractor supports the full claim.

S037-06.notes: Probes shifted with landmarks directly implicate landmark memory and rule out smell (seeds didn't move) and random search. Matches Vander Wall 1982. B shows own-cache advantage but doesn't isolate landmarks from smell; A, D irrelevant.

S037-07.notes: Tools, wedges, platforms, contemporaneous hearths, and shape-matching gaps at the Preseli outcrops indicate human quarrying, countering glacial transport. A contradicts Text 2; C contradicts Welsh source; D not addressed. Facts (Preseli, ~230 km, Parker Pearson's Craig Rhos-y-felin/Carn Goedog excavations) accurate.

flags: minor: the Ge Hong recipe says to steep sweet wormwood in water and wring out juice; 'cold water' is the standard popular gloss and acceptable
S037-08.notes: Goal is where the clue came from: the 1,600-year-old text. Only C names it. Facts (1969, 2,000+ remedies, low-temp extraction, 2015 shared Nobel) accurate.

S037-09.notes: Drawbacks followed by 'remains the standard' = concession, so 'Still.' Consequently/For instance/Similarly illogical. ~50,000-year limit accurate.

S037-10.notes: 'had' + past participle = had written (past perfect with 'By the time... retired'). Wrote, writing, writes ungrammatical after 'had'.
